**001-url-ingest**

Trigger: Mnemo API POSTs `{note_id, url}`.
Flow: HMAC verify → fetch URL → trafilatura/Readability → summarize (LLM) → tag (LLM) → callback Mnemo with processed_content/summary/tags.
Failure modes: trafilatura returns empty (Playwright fallback in milestone-2), upstream LLM 5xx (retried 3x).
